title: REQ · Frozen export has a documented stable JSON format with only frozen contributions
summary: Exporter builds versioned JSON from a source interface, filtered to frozen IDs, empty round gives empty array
description: Add an Exporter in backend/internal/contribution that reads a round via an ExportSource interface (ListByRound, FrozenIDs) and returns an Export struct with stable JSON tags: version, world, round, contributions[{id, author, content, created_at}]. Package docs describe the format and lifecycle (only closed rounds with a snapshot are exportable).
acceptance_criteria: Given a source with 3 contributions of which 2 are frozen, When Export is called, Then output lists exactly the 2 frozen ones ordered by created_at then id
Given a frozen set that is empty, When Export is called, Then contributions marshals to []
Given a round not yet frozen, When Export is called, Then ErrNotFrozen is returned

in_scope: export.go with Export types, Exporter, ErrNotFrozen, format doc comment

technical_constraints: JSON field names fixed: version, world, round, contributions, id, author, content, created_at (RFC3339 UTC)
definition_of_done: Format documented in package comment of export.go
